tagline: Know your teacher before you enrol.
design_philosophy: Apple-inspired minimal design with generous white space, large confident headlines, system font hierarchy, near-black text on crisp white and light grey (#f5f5f7) sections, soft 18px rounded cards, pill-shaped action buttons, and pure #0071e3 blue accents. Self-explanatory, zero jargon, zero dark patterns, fully responsive.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript React components (.js or .jsx).
Build the 3-way view switcher in the top sticky bar: 'I want to learn' | 'I teach' | 'I'm an edtech platform'. Ensure smooth view transitions.

Learner view must include Hero query field, 3 sample prompt chips (e.g. 'System Design for Senior Devs', 'Hands-on React & Next.js', 'Math for Machine Learning'), AI match top 3 cards with match percentage + plain English reasons, browse grid with filters (skill, platform, min rating, years) & sort by Bodhak score.

Instructor card must contain avatar, name, headline, top 3 skill tags, platform chips (Udemy, Coursera, upGrad, Great Learning, Offline), years of experience, Bodhak Score (out of 5), and number of learner stories.

Instructor Profile detail page/modal must show: header, avatar, name, headline, years, industry role, Verified badge, large Bodhak Score /5 with ratings count, 'Teaches on' platforms, Skills chips, Upcoming batches, AI summary (Strengths / Could be better / Best suited for), Learner stories list, Share your story form, disabled 'Book a 1:1' button.

Instructor View: Heading + plain English description, 'View as' profile dropdown, 'Create new profile' button + form, Analytics Dashboard with Bodhak Score, total stories count, Recharts Bar Chart (rating by platform), Recharts Line Chart (rating trend), AI Summary with 'What to improve'.

Edtech View: Heading + plain English description, describe-instructor prompt input, ranked list with reasons, leaderboard table by skill, 'Add to shortlist' button, and 'My Shortlist' slide-over/panel.
Footer text: 'Demo prototype. All instructors and stories are synthetic.'
Add testids to every interactive element (data-testid='...').
Follow Apple HIG aesthetic: lots of white space, crisp SF Pro font hierarchy, subtle borders, 18px soft radius cards, and #0071e3 blue accents.
Do NOT use any Apple logos or trademarks.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use dark gradients for cards or sections.
Keep text contrast high and clear according to WCAG/APCA rules.
Use sonner for user feedback (e.g. when sharing a story or adding an instructor to shortlist).
Ensure all buttons have explicit text stating their exact action.
All cards must have p-6 or p-8 internal padding and soft hover elevation.
